text:
Nina (Partnerships): Hey team — CloudScale sent final assets for the marketplace tile and solution brief. Need a quick logo + hero crop review. Drive: https://drive.company/cloudscale-redwood

assets-bot: Uploaded: cloudscale_logos.zip, cloudscale_brief_v1.pdf, screenshots.zip

Theo (Design): Opening. Two logo options: round mark and horizontal lockup. For 1200x600 tile I recommend round mark only.

Priya (Brand Ops): Confirm we have signed brand permission? Also need SVG with 16px clearspace, white mono for dark, and no drop shadows.

Nina (Partnerships): Brand permission is attached in Drive (cloudscale_brand_ok.pdf).

Lucas (Marketing): Tile headline idea: "CloudScale + Redwood: faster GenAI inference, lower cost" 2-line blurb + CTA "Read case study". Need a 140-char metadata line for listing.

Ruth (Legal): Please blur customer names in screenshots and remove any unapproved revenue claims. If we say "2x savings" include appendix reference. I'll review tonight.

Theo (Design): I'll export 1200x600, 600x300, and thumb 300x150 in PNG and WebP. Will add alt text: "CloudScale dashboard with Redwood routing overlay".

Priya (Brand Ops): Also send a dark BG mock with mono logo. Keep 40px clearspace.

Nina (Partnerships): Timeline: mocks by Wed AM, legal signoff Wed EOD, final assets Thurs. Everyone OK?

Ruth (Legal): Will aim to finish by Wed EOD.

Lucas (Marketing): I'll draft the marketplace blurb and short metadata by Tue noon.

Theo (Design): Uploading figma mock -> https://figma.com/file/cloudscale-mock#v3

Nina (Partnerships): Great, thanks all. I'll schedule the listing once final assets and legal signoff are in. Closing thread after uploads.
